title: Understanding k-Means Clustering
text: In k-Means clustering, the algorithm aims to partition the data into k clusters by minimizing the sum of squared distances between data points and their respective cluster centroids.

title: Convergence in k-Means
text: The convergence of k-Means depends on the initial placement of centroids. It may not always reach the global minimum, but it will converge to a local minimum.

title: Evaluating the Statement
